discoveries.title: カテゴリー理論ツール群 × 投資分析フレームワーク
discoveries.description: Probe A: Category Theory/Sheaf Theory/Functorial Data Migration (technology) ↔ Causal Emergence (indicator) ↔ David Spivak (person) が14共有Factで密結合。Sheaf理論によるアナリストレポートの局所→グローバル整合性集約が投資判断に応用可能。マクロ政策→セクター→個別株への因果伝播をfunctor/sheaf構造でモデル化できる可能性。
supporting_evidence: Wiring diagrams built on ologs enable quantitative measurement of analogy between concepts from different domains
Sheaf-theoretic causal emergence enables detection and measurement of emergent resilience in networked systems
For AI emergent discovery on graph databases, five key categorical concepts are applicable: Functors, Sheaves, Adjoint functors, Kan extensions, Natural transformations
